svg.title: Measured, on a log-log axis: the curves separate where the counts said
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Measured, on a log-log axis: the curves separate where the counts said” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn log-log plot of sorting time against array size. A green merge-sort line of slope 1.06 and a blue qsort line of slope 1.11 run almost parallel, with qsort 1.75 times slower; a red selection-sort line of slope 1.95 climbs far more steeply and is continued as a dashed extrapolation off the top of the chart. An inset shows insertion sort at 1700 nanoseconds beating merge sort at n equals 96, and a crossed-out box denies that big-O tells you which algorithm is faster.
